{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any systematic differences between segments in other variables that might confound conversion rate
# Specifically, check if customer_age or channel distribution differs by customer_segment

# Cross-tabulate customer_segment with channel and customer_age
channel_by_segment = pd.crosstab(sales_df['customer_segment'], sales_df['channel'])
print("Channel distribution by segment:\n", channel_by_segment)

age_by_segment = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['customer_age'].describe()
print("\nCustomer age distribution by segment:\n", age_by_segment)"}
